decisions.summary: split the extra volume of Printed fabric type 1 with a second supplier

messages.author: EMP-010
messages.text: Can Campbell-Clark [SYNTH] cover a 20% forecast increase on Printed fabric type 1 in Q3?

messages.author: EMP-012
messages.text: They can do 10% from the current plant, the rest needs overtime.

messages.author: EMP-010
messages.text: Decision: split the extra volume of Printed fabric type 1 with a second supplier.
